page.layout: One page of text in one column; below it, a catchword-like signature mark at the right; faint show-through text from the reverse page in the lower right, not transcribed.

main_text.p: vel maximè audiendi sunt, didicis- sem; operæpretium me facturum exi- stimavi, ea quæ ab aliis præterita fuerunt adiungere, & perperam ac- cepta atque tradita corrigere, atque ita peritioribus occasionem dare, suas quoque observationes publico im- pertiendi. Addidi & Icones aliquot accuratè expressas; quasdam quoque è Gesnero & aliis huc transtuli. De- nique præmisi Theophrasti li- brum de Lapidibus, qui licet mutilus sit, tamen uti à summo Philosopho scriptus, merito magni faciendus est. Quam meam operam ut boni consu- las rogo, & si quid rectius nosti, can- dide impertias.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page (lower right) is not transcribed. The signature mark "IN" with a small 4 is read as printed at the lower right; uncertain. The word "suas" appears as "fuas" in the scan and is printed as "suas" here; the scan may show a long-s form, so treat with [?] if doubtful. Ligature "Theophrasti" is set in small capitals in the scan.
